cases.name: pre_commit_gates
cases.prompt: What do I run before committing a Rust change to torc?
assertions: notes that --all-features requires a database or the .sqlx cache

cases.name: api_change_chain
cases.prompt: I need to add a query parameter to an existing torc API endpoint.
assertions: runs api/sync_openapi.sh to emit, check, and regenerate clients
bumps HTTP_API_VERSION in src/api_version.rs for a new optional parameter
does not hand-edit generated client code

cases.name: client_parity_failure
cases.prompt: CI fails with check_client_codegen_parity.sh reporting a diff. Fix it.
assertions: reproduces locally with the api sync or parity script
regenerates the clients instead of editing the diff away
notes that the generator version and image digest are pinned

cases.name: flaky_shared_state_test
cases.prompt: My new integration test binary passes alone but fails when the whole torc suite runs.
assertions: uses serial_test in the source for shared-resource tests
registers the binary in a test group in .config/nextest.toml
explains that nextest runs each binary in a separate process so #[serial] alone is not enough

cases.name: new_cli_command_conventions
cases.prompt: Add a torc CLI command that lists a new server resource.
assertions: supports -f json via the shared output helpers
paginates instead of issuing one unbounded request
accepts an optional workflow ID with interactive selection following existing commands
adds tests and documentation including the CLI cheat sheet
